events.name: agent-loop/config-start-failed
events.description: A declarative agent entry failed before it could publish a live agent.

events.name: agent-preset/selected
events.description: One session committed a different agent preset to its durable log.

events.name: agent/assistant-stream
events.description: Process-local assistant-stream publication.
events.signature: 'agent/assistant-stream'(this: Scoped<Agent>, payload: { agent: Agent; frame: AssistantStreamFrame }): void

events.name: agent/created
events.description: An entered agent is ready for per-agent initialization after factory setup.
events.signature: 'agent/created'(this: Scoped<Agent>, payload: { agent: Agent; source: SessionStartSource; signal?: AbortSignal }): undefined | Promise<undefined>

events.name: agent/disposed
events.description: An agent left the registry; AgentLoop emits this after driver quiescence and scoped-registration unwind, but before session detachment.

events.name: agent/error
events.description: A step or turn errored.
events.signature: 'agent/error'(this: Scoped<Agent>, payload: { agent: Agent; turn: number; step: number; error: unknown }): void

events.name: agent/inbox/claimed
events.description: One message left the inbox inside its open turn.
events.signature: 'agent/inbox/claimed'(this: Scoped<Agent>, payload: { agent: Agent; message: UserMessage; turn: number }): void

events.name: agent/inbox/discarded
events.description: One message was discarded from the live inbox.
events.signature: 'agent/inbox/discarded'(this: Scoped<Agent>, payload: { agent: Agent; message: UserMessage }): void

events.name: agent/inbox/inserted
events.description: One message entered the live inbox.
events.signature: 'agent/inbox/inserted'(this: Scoped<Agent>, payload: { agent: Agent; message: UserMessage }): void

events.name: agent/pre-step
events.description: Reject a proposed step or replace the messages that enter it.
events.signature: 'agent/pre-step'(this: Scoped<Agent>, payload: { agent: Agent; messages: UserMessage[]; turn: number; step: number; signal: AbortSignal }, next: () => Promise<PreStepDecision>): Promise<PreStepDecision>

events.name: agent/request
events.description: Replace the frozen call configuration.
events.signature: 'agent/request'(this: Scoped<Agent>, payload: { agent: Agent; turn: number; step: number; signal: AbortSignal }, next: () => Promise<LlmCallConfig>): Promise<LlmCallConfig>

events.name: agent/request-error
events.description: Handle one failed model-request attempt before the loop retries or closes its step.
events.signature: 'agent/request-error'(this: Scoped<Agent>, payload: { agent: Agent; turn: number; step: number; provider: string; failure: LlmFailure; retryPolicy: ResolvedRetryPolicy | undefined; signal: AbortSignal }, next: () => Promise<RequestErrorAction>): Promise<RequestErrorAction>

events.name: agent/status
events.description: Agent status changed (`idle` ⇄ `running`).
events.signature: 'agent/status'(this: Scoped<Agent>, payload: { agent: Agent; status: AgentStatus }): void

events.name: agent/turn-stopping
events.description: The turn is about to close: the model owes no response (no live tool calls, no fresh steering).
events.signature: 'agent/turn-stopping'(this: Scoped<Agent>, payload: { agent: Agent; turn: number; signal: AbortSignal }): Promise<void> | void

events.name: api-session/activity
events.description: One user-authored durable message advanced Session list activity.

events.name: api-session/added
events.description: A Session became visible or its Agent was created or disposed.

events.name: api-session/error
events.description: One Agent failed outside a durable turn position.

events.name: api-session/removed
events.description: A Session left the live Host registry.

events.name: api-session/status
events.description: One Agent changed running state.

events.name: app-boot/config-reload
events.description: Profile patches were reconciled into the running Loader tree: every entry update settled and no new inactive entry was introduced.

events.name: approval/request
events.description: Ask composed answerers for one decision.
events.signature: 'approval/request'( this: Scoped<Agent>, req: ApprovalRequestEvent, next: () => Promise<ApprovalOutcome>, ): Promise<ApprovalOutcome>

events.name: authorization/settled
events.description: One authorization attempt has finished and released its key.

events.name: commands/change
events.description: A command was registered or unregistered.

events.name: compaction/summary-error
events.description: Recover a failed summary request by synchronously recording a durable change to its selected input.
events.signature: 'compaction/summary-error'(payload: { session: Session; sourceEventSeqs: readonly SessionSeq[]; error: unknown; signal?: AbortSignal }, next: () => boolean): boolean

events.name: connection/request
events.description: Admit or wrap an authenticated shared API request, including body transfer.
events.signature: 'connection/request'(request: IncomingMessage, response: ServerResponse, next: () => Promise<void>): Promise<void>

events.name: credentials/record-updated
events.description: Committed change to a stored credential record: a `modifyRecord` that wrote, a `deleteRecord` that removed, or an external edit observed in storage.

events.name: credentials/reference-updated
events.description: Committed change to a provider-managed credential source: a `set`, an `unset`, or an external edit observed in storage.

events.name: deepseek-account/model-sign-in-required
events.description: An account model request requires the user to sign in.

events.name: deepseek-account/session-expired
events.description: Server rejection removed the current account credential; this notification is not replayed.

events.name: deepseek-account/signed-out
events.description: Local grant removal has completed.

events.name: domain/changed
events.description: A domain record or the global singleton changed, emitted once per write strictly after the backend acknowledged durability.

events.name: feedback/committed
events.description: Observe a durable cold feedback mutation without publishing a live Session.

events.name: fs/edit-intent
events.description: Single-slot decision for the next FileSystem.editText.
events.signature: 'fs/edit-intent'(target: FsTarget, actor: object | undefined, next: () => { version: FsVersion } | undefined | Promise<{ version: FsVersion } | undefined>): Promise<{ version: FsVersion } | undefined>

events.name: fs/observed
events.description: Record an authoritative positive or negative observation.
events.signature: 'fs/observed'(target: FsTarget, observation: FsObservation, actor: object | undefined): void

events.name: fs/write-intent
events.description: Single-slot decision for the next FileSystem.writeText.
events.signature: 'fs/write-intent'(target: FsTarget, actor: object | undefined, next: () => FsWriteIntent | undefined | Promise<FsWriteIntent | undefined>): Promise<FsWriteIntent | undefined>

events.name: goal/activation-changed
events.description: Process-local goal activation changed for one session.

events.name: goal/changed
events.description: Goal mutation accepted by one live agent.
events.signature: 'goal/changed'(this: import('@deepseek-ai/dsh-scope').Scoped<Agent>, payload: { agent: Agent; change: GoalChanged }): void

events.name: hmr/change
events.description: A watched file has no module or configuration handler.

events.name: hmr/reload
events.description: Module replacements have finished loading.

events.name: llm/adapters-updated
events.description: The provider topology changed: an adapter registered or unregistered routes, or the configurable-provider directory gained or lost entries.

events.name: llm/stream
events.description: Waterfall around every streaming model call (retry, replay, routing).
events.signature: 'llm/stream'(this: LlmRuntime, options: GenerateOptions, next: () => AsyncIterable<StreamChunk>): AsyncIterable<StreamChunk>

events.name: permission-presets/catalog-changed
events.description: The selectable process catalog changed.

events.name: plugin-manager/changed
events.description: The profile's plugins, bundles, or composition changed: a manager operation completed.

events.name: plugin-manager/install-log
events.description: One chunk of a pnpm run's output, streamed as the run produces it.

events.name: plugin-manager/install-state
events.description: An installation moved between its Host phases.

events.name: plugin-market/changed
events.description: The configured index sources changed.

events.name: schedule/changed
events.description: Durable task set changed; clients refetch global task and Session-active catalogs.

events.name: session-telemetry/record
events.description: Transform one outbound record before it reaches the backend.

events.name: session/created
events.description: Creation announcement during session publication.

events.name: session/disposed
events.description: Emitted once when an announced session leaves the store, including publication rollback, but never for an entry whose creation announcement did not begin.

events.name: session/event
events.description: Post-commit, fire-and-forget append feed.
events.signature: 'session/event'(this: Scoped<Session>, session: Session, event: SessionEvent): void

events.name: session/flush
events.description: Awaited parallel durability checkpoint: every listener runs and the caller awaits all of them, with no waterfall veto.

events.name: settings/document-updated
events.description: One profile entry's form values, availability, or page policy changed.

events.name: skills/change
events.description: A skill provider, runtime contribution, or provider-backed catalog may have changed.

events.name: subagent/end
events.description: A published child settled.

events.name: subagent/provider-added
events.description: A provider became resolvable in the registry.

events.name: subagent/provider-removed
events.description: A provider left the registry.

events.name: subagent/start
events.description: A provider established a published child.

events.name: system-prompt/assemble
events.description: Expert waterfall over the assembled sections, contexts, tools, and variables.
events.signature: 'system-prompt/assemble'(this: Scoped<SystemPrompt>, assembly: PromptAssembly, context: AssembleContext, next: () => Promise<PromptAssembly>): Promise<PromptAssembly>

events.name: system-prompt/change
events.description: Emitted when any prompt provider changes.

events.name: tools/change
events.description: A tool was registered or unregistered, or a scoped restriction changed (the available tool set changed — possibly for one scope only).

events.name: tools/execute
events.description: Around-dispatch waterfall for timeout, retry, or metrics.
events.signature: 'tools/execute'(this: Scoped<ToolRuntime>, exec: ToolDispatchExecution, next: () => Promise<ToolExecutionResult>): Promise<ToolExecutionResult>

events.name: tools/post-execute
events.description: Accept, replace, enrich, or block a normalized dispatch result.
events.signature: 'tools/post-execute'(this: Scoped<ToolRuntime>, exec: ToolExecution, result: Readonly<ToolExecutionResult>, next: () => Promise<PostToolDecision>): Promise<PostToolDecision>

events.name: tools/pre-execute
events.description: Allow, deny, cancel, or ask before dispatch.
events.signature: 'tools/pre-execute'(this: Scoped<ToolRuntime>, exec: ToolExecution, next: () => Promise<PreToolDecision>): Promise<PreToolDecision>

events.name: tools/ptc-dispatch-log
events.description: Allow a listener to replace content in the DURABLE LOG COPY of one `run_code` sub-dispatch outcome before the bridge appends its `tool/ptc-dispatch` event.
events.signature: 'tools/ptc-dispatch-log'(this: Scoped<ToolRuntime>, dispatch: PtcDispatchLog, next: () => Promise<ContentBlock[]>): Promise<ContentBlock[]>

events.name: tools/result
events.description: Observe the frozen, lossless-JSON final outcome.
events.signature: 'tools/result'(this: Scoped<ToolRuntime>, exec: Readonly<ToolExecution>, result: Readonly<ToolExecutionResult>): undefined

events.name: user-questions/request
events.description: Ask composed answerers for structured user input.
events.signature: 'user-questions/request'( this: Scoped<Agent>, request: AskUserQuestionRequestEvent, next: () => Promise<AskUserQuestionAnswer>, ): Promise<AskUserQuestionAnswer>

events.name: webserver/index-inject
events.description: Collect the structured index injection table.

events.name: workflow/agent-end
events.description: One `agent()` call settled (clean result, child failure, or run cancellation).

events.name: workflow/agent-start
events.description: One `agent()` call established a published child run.

events.name: workflow/end
events.description: A workflow run settled (any stop reason).

events.name: workflow/log
events.description: The script emitted a narration line (a `log(message)` call).

events.name: workflow/phase
events.description: The script entered a phase (a `phase(title)` call) — progress grouping for observers; no execution semantics.

events.name: workflow/start
events.description: A workflow run started — the script's meta block validated, the body about to execute.

events.name: workspace/session-activity
events.description: Ask the composed providers what still runs for a session before it is archived.
events.signature: 'workspace/session-activity'( request: SessionActivityRequest, next: () => Promise<readonly SessionActivity[]>, ): Promise<readonly SessionActivity[]>

events.name: workspace/session-stop
events.description: Stop a session's running work because the caller archived it with `stopActivity`; the archive set is durable when this dispatches.
